title: pipeline.py --redate fails on the frozen work store (STALE SNAPSHOT: redate() reads export files, append() expects work_store:vN)
note: Found by lane TRADING-T1-BATCH 2026-11-12. Repro: python3 scripts/ops/pipeline.py --redate PI-20261106-Y7JEXUWW-0006 --next-due 2026-11-14 --observation '<text>'. Cause: scripts/ops/pipeline.py redate() takes based_on from read_log(store).sources (export filename) while append() on a frozen canonical store compares against work_store:v<N>. Fix: use version_of()/get_observation in redate(). Workaround: work.py observe. Also: the how_to_check path journal?account_id=... in that item returns HTTP 422; use journal?table=trades.
